title: 'Ye 12-15 saal khelenge': Goenka's old prediction on Rishabh Pant goes viral

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a groundbreaking decision, the US Senate has passed a resolution that requires congressional consent for any further military action against Iran. This marks a pivotal moment in challenging President Trump's military strategy. Although the vote was close and a presidential veto is anticipated, the legislation reflects increasing anxiety regarding the rationale and economic repercussions of the ongoing conflict.
title: In a first, US Senate votes to halt Trump’s Iran war; President fumes, calls move 'meaningless'

author: MANVEER SAINI
description: Haryana's education and agriculture departments saw another IAS officer, Pankaj Aggarwal, arrested in a Rs 60.5 crore funds swindle.  He allegedly approved opening bank accounts and transferred vast sums, violating guidelines. This arrest follows that of former Panchkula municipal commissioner RK Singh, with both cases linked to a larger Rs 593 crore scam across eight state departments. The CBI is investigating the alleged siphoning of funds through shell entities.
title: IAS officer held for siphoning Rs 60 crore from Haryana govt a/cs

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Rishabh Pant has returned to Delhi Capitals in a significant trade deal, exchanging places with spinner Kuldeep Yadav who moves to Lucknow Super Giants. Pant's two-year stint with LSG, marked by struggles and disappointing team performances, concluded with a simple "Thank you team" message. This move sees Pant take a pay cut but reunites him with his former franchise after a challenging period.
title: Rishabh Pant's three-word message to LSG after return to Delhi Capitals

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Iran's President Pezeshkian has asserted that the missile program is strictly defensive and isn't covered by any agreements with the US. He highlighted its importance for national security, likening Iran's situation to that of Gaza. This declaration surfaces during discussions on a 14-point MoU, which does not include any terms on missile limitations and is centered solely on nuclear arms.
title: 'Without missiles, we'd be like Gaza': Tehran rejects US calls to limit its defence arsenal

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Mac Jones has finally addressed the growing trade rumors surrounding his future with the San Francisco 49ers. Speaking on The Rich Eisen Show, Jones made his feelings clear about staying in San Francisco while also admitting that anything can happen before the trade deadline. With a strong 2025 campaign behind him and several quarterback-needy teams keeping tabs, his future remains one of the biggest storylines heading into the 2026 NFL season
title: Mac Jones finally breaks silence on San Francisco 49ers trade drama with bold admission

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: A fire erupted in labour slums near Delhi's Udyog Bhawan on Wednesday, originating from an electric panel and spreading to temporary structures. Around 20 fire tenders battled the blaze, bringing it under control by 5:30 am. No casualties have been reported. This incident follows a major slum fire behind Maulana Azad Medical College days earlier, which involved residential areas and storage facilities, including plywood, leading to rapid fire spread.
title: Major fire breaks out in Delhi labour settlement near Udyog Bhawan, no injuries reported

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Cristiano Ronaldo responded to criticism in emphatic fashion, scoring twice in Portugal’s 5-0 World Cup victory over Uzbekistan to become the first player to score in six different World Cups and Portugal’s all-time leading World Cup goalscorer. The veteran also dismissed retirement talk, declared “I’m back,” and showed little interest in discussing Lionel Messi after the match.
title: 'Next question': Ronaldo refuses journalist's question about Messi

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: China's AI race with the US is heating up, with Zhipu CEO Tang Jie asserting they are not far behind. A recent exchange with Elon Musk highlighted this, as Zhipu's new GLM-5.2 model shows impressive performance, even outperforming OpenAI's GPT-5.5 in some benchmarks. This development has boosted Zhipu's stock significantly, signaling a strong contender emerging from China in the global AI landscape.
title: Chinese AI company CEO 'corrects' Elon Musk on China launching Anthropic Fable 5-kind AI model

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Cristiano Ronaldo scored twice as Portugal thrashed Uzbekistan 5-0 to strengthen their FIFA World Cup 2026 knockout hopes and rewrite national history. The 41-year-old became Portugal’s all-time leading World Cup goalscorer with 10 goals, surpassing Eusébio’s 60-year-old record, while also extending his own record as the first player to score in six different World Cup tournaments.
title: Ronaldo ends 60-year wait, breaks Portugal World Cup record

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The UN is actively facilitating the evacuation of approximately 11,000 sailors from the Strait of Hormuz, a critical move emerging from a recent US-Iran peace accord. While maritime activities begin to resume, disputes linger regarding the future management and potential tariffs of the strait's usage. The US upholds its position of global navigation rights, contrasting with Iran's indication that it may resist returning to pre-conflict norms, signaling future negotiations ahead.
title: UN launches evacuation of 11,000 sailors stranded in Hormuz

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Bengal and Delhi Capitals cricketer Abishek Porel faces serious allegations after a woman filed a police complaint accusing him of a broken promise of marriage, assault, and criminal intimidation. The woman claims a three-year relationship soured last year, with Porel allegedly backing out of marriage plans. Porel has vehemently denied the accusations, calling them baseless and suggesting they are timed with his recent cricketing success. An investigation is underway.
title: Delhi Capitals cricketer accused of sexual relationship under false promise of marriage

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Former India cricketer Mohammad Kaif has backed Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma to play in the 2027 ODI World Cup, citing Rohit's fitness, passion and improved batting approach. Kaif also believes India will be favourites for the tournament, with most members of the 2023 World Cup squad, including Bumrah, Gill, Rahul, Iyer and Kuldeep, expected to remain part of the team.
title: 'I will take the guarantee of Kohli, Rohit': Ex-India star makes bold 2027 ODI WC claim

author: VISHAL PATADIYA
description: Damage To Vehicle  Undisputed, Says Consumer Panel
title: No proof of accident, but car owner wins Rs 1.25 lakh claim

author: TNN
description: Varanasi is once again embroiled in controversy after a video surfaced showing men cooking meat and drinking alcohol on a Ganga boat. Police swiftly arrested five individuals, filing charges related to promoting enmity and outraging religious sentiments. This incident follows similar past events involving religious gatherings and alleged disrespect towards the sacred river, highlighting ongoing tensions.
title: Five arrested, boat seized after video of meat, liquor party on Ganga goes viral

author: ISHITA JAIRATH
description: Delhi's Public Works Department is launching structural audits for 44 flyovers older than 15 years, with some dating back three decades. This proactive measure, costing Rs 11 crore, aims to identify and address potential safety risks before they become critical. The initiative underscores a commitment to preventive maintenance and ensuring the long-term safety and reliability of the city's vital infrastructure for its citizens.
title: Identify, repair, recast: 44 flyovers over 15 years old to undergo structural audit

author: ABHAY
description: A 10-year-old girl was abducted and murdered by a cab driver in South Delhi after being pulled from a pavement where her family was sleeping. Her father recounted the harrowing moments of her final cry, 'Papa...', as he desperately tried to save her. The family, migrants seeking a better life, had been forced onto the streets due to financial hardship.
title: 'Papa…': Final call of 10-yr-old abducted from pavement; father chased cab driver with stick

author: ABHAY
description: A father's fragmented memory of a white car and a yellow plate initiated a swift investigation. Investigators pieced together a digital trail, including CCTV footage and cab aggregator data, to track down Basu Kumar Singh, a driver accused of abducting, raping, and murdering a 10-year-old girl. The suspect was apprehended within seven hours of the initial report, later confessing to the heinous crime.
title: Delhi 10-yr-old rape & murder: How father's memory, digital trail led police to suspected cabbie
